## The trap

The Change Feed is a **projection** over completion sources — `harness_shared.work_items`, `gym_proposals`, `harness_plans` (see `curation/change-feed-deps.ts`). Every one of its readers is a **top-N recency window**:

```sql
... ORDER BY <clock> DESC LIMIT 500
```

Scout's (and su-ideate's) lens-weight learning works by joining a **routed-idea ledger** (`scout_routed_ideas.routed_ref`) to that feed each cycle and asking "did this idea's artifact reach a winning terminal?" (`classifyIdeaOutcome`). The classifier is grade-blind and **presence-based**: a ref that isn't in the feed classifies `pending`.

So the moment a winning artifact **ages past the top-500 window**, the join stops finding it → the idea flips back to `pending` → the per-lens `decided/won` counts drop → `upsertScoutLensWeights` **overwrites the persisted weights back toward uniform**. The learning is **transient, not durable**: a win moves the weights only while its artifact stays in the feed window, then the next refresh forgets it.

This is a *silent* failure — no error, no red test. The weights just quietly drift to uniform despite decided-won ideas sitting in the ledger.

## It has recurred (fix the class, not the instance)

- **su-ideate** hit it first — `su-ideate-learning-substrate P-016` added `readSuRefScopedTerminalEntries` (work_items terminals scoped to the ledger's own `wi:` refs, **no LIMIT**).
- **scout** hit the *same* window, but the P-016 augmentation was gated to `if (origin === 'su-ideate')` — scout never got it (**EI-11978**). Fixed by `readScoutRefScopedTerminalEntries` covering all three scout rails (`wi:`/`gym:`/`plan:`).

If you wire a **new** outcome-learning origin (or a new rail) that joins a ledger to the feed, you will hit this a third time.

## The fix shape

Fold in **ledger-ref-scoped, window-free** terminal reads for exactly the refs being classified, appended AFTER the feed (so first-wins `dedupById` keeps the feed's richer entry). Scope the ref-subquery to `(workspace + origin [+ harnessSlug] [+ cycleId])`.

**Mirror the feed reader's semantics** except for the window — do NOT just drop every guard:

- `work_items`: keep the **winning statuses** AND the WI-1403/WI-1405 **completion-integrity pair** (`terminal_owner` + `terminal_completion_ref`). Dropping the integrity pair recovers hygiene/dedup terminal flips as "wins" and inflates a lens's win-rate with non-genuine work. (su deliberately drops it AND folds `deprecated` losses — that's su's design, not a template to copy blindly; scout folds **wins only**, so a `deprecated` ref still classifies `pending`.)
- `gym_proposals`: the decided-both-ways statuses the feed already carries.
- `harness_plans`: `op_status = 'done'`.

## Testing it

The behavior is a SQL window effect — a pure unit test can't capture "aged out of a `LIMIT 500`". The faithful regression test is an **integration** test (real PG): seed the win, then insert **>500 newer** qualifying completions to push it out of the window, and assert (a) the raw `gatherCompletions` feed **drops** it (guards against a false green) and (b) the outcome read **recovers** it as `won`. See the EI-11978 test in `routed-ledger.integration.test.ts`.
